record.oneLiner: DataForSEO provides comprehensive SEO, SERP, and keyword research REST APIs authenticated via HTTP Basic auth with self-serve free signup.
record.verdictReason: DataForSEO offers a fully documented REST API with self-serve free registration and HTTP Basic authentication, making it completely buildable into agent toolkits without any approval gates.

evidence.quote: DataForSEO is using the Basic Authentication, which makes it possible to call our APIs with almost any programming language, Postman app, REST API platforms, and all major frameworks.
1. Create a free account. DataForSEO adds $1 in trial credit when you sign up.
